style: Bold, witty editorial illustration in a flat screen-print (risograph) style: a limited palette of hot pink, sunflower yellow, cobalt blue, mint green and deep navy on warm off-white paper; visible print grain and slight colour misregistration; chunky simple shapes, clever visual jokes, quirky characters with simple dot eyes and expressive poses; generous empty space around the subject. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere. Original characters only, not in the style of any living illustrator.
